exclusions.reason: Its current official Chinese Language and Culture and ICLT records already exist in the formal catalog; no semantic duplicate was emitted.
The accessible official ICLT guide is for 2025. No stale cycle was presented as current 2026 data.
Absent from the formal catalog, and no official 2026 international-student page proving an individually applicable Chinese program was found. Domestic catalogs were excluded.
Formal records already cover Chinese refresher, HSK, ICL Education master's/doctorate and TCSOL bachelor's programs.
Current formal program and scholarship records already cover its verified international Chinese routes.
Domestic-student catalogs, degree-authorisation lists and department pages without explicit international eligibility were not used.

notes: Guangzhou University retains the highest-priority three-source evidence chain for its three-year International Chinese Language Education master's.
Fifteen institutions retain 25 cross-pack-deduplicated candidate programs; GDUFS December 2026 and Hainan University March 2027 remain open.
SCNU master's/doctorate, YNNU master's and the overlapping SCNU ICLT scholarship are supplied by core-degree-pack.json and are intentionally omitted here.
All expired 2026 cycles are closed; unknown dynamic facts use explicit FactStatus values.
Four scholarship candidates remain linked only to program candidate IDs present in this package.
No domestic-student major list was treated as proof of international eligibility.
